description: A ticket that already lists criteria. The analyst must keep them and their numbers, and add rather than renumber.

input.title: Log out from the menu
input.body:
As a shopper I want to log out from the menu so that nobody else can use my session.

| | Kind | Given | When | Then |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | happy | a signed-in shopper | they choose Logout in the menu | the login page is shown |
| AC-2 | negative | a shopper who logged out | they open /inventory.html directly | the login page is shown with an error |
| AC-3 | edge | a shopper with items in the cart | they log out and sign in again | the cart still holds the items |
